shortDescription: Create, update or delete a instance via the marketplace.

options.name: access_token
options.description: An access token.

options.name: api_url
options.description: Fully qualified URL to the API.

options.name: availability_zone
options.description: Availability zone where this instance is located This attribute cannot be updated.

options.name: config_drive
options.description: Force config drive on or off for this instance. If null, the tenant-wide default from service settings is used. This attribute cannot be updated.

options.name: connect_directly_to_external_network
options.description: If True, instance will be connected directly to external network This attribute cannot be updated.

options.name: customer
options.description: The name or UUID of the customer to filter the project lookup. This is useful when a project name is not unique across all customers.

options.name: data_volume_size
options.description: Size of the data volume in MiB. Minimum size is 1024 MiB (1 GiB). The value should be provided in GiB and will be converted to MiB. The value should be provided in GiB and will be converted to MiB. This attribute cannot be updated.

options.name: data_volume_type
options.description: Volume type for the data volume This attribute cannot be updated.

options.name: data_volumes
options.description: Additional data volumes to attach to the instance This attribute cannot be updated.

options.name: delete_volumes
options.description: If true, delete attached volumes on termination.

options.name: description
options.description: Description

options.name: flavor
options.description: The flavor to use for the instance Required when C(state) is 'present'. This attribute cannot be updated.

options.name: floating_ips
options.description: Floating IPs to assign to the instance

options.name: image
options.description: The OS image to use for the instance Required when C(state) is 'present'. This attribute cannot be updated.

options.name: interval
options.description: The interval in seconds for polling the async action status.

options.name: name
options.description: Name Required when C(state) is 'present'.

options.name: offering
options.description: The name or UUID of the marketplace offering. Required when C(state) is 'present'. This attribute cannot be updated.

options.name: plan
options.description: URL of the marketplace plan. This attribute cannot be updated.

options.name: ports
options.description: Network ports to attach to the instance Required when C(state) is 'present'.

options.name: project
options.description: The name or UUID of the project. Required when C(state) is 'present'. This attribute cannot be updated.

options.name: release_floating_ips
options.description: If true, release associated floating IPs on termination.

options.name: security_groups
options.description: List of security groups to apply to the instance

options.name: server_group
options.description: Server group for instance scheduling policy This attribute cannot be updated.

options.name: ssh_public_key
options.description: The name or UUID of the SSH public key. This attribute cannot be updated.

options.name: state
options.description: Should the resource be present or absent.

options.name: system_volume_size
options.description: Size of the system volume in MiB. Minimum size is 1024 MiB (1 GiB). The value should be provided in GiB and will be converted to MiB. The value should be provided in GiB and will be converted to MiB. Required when C(state) is 'present'. This attribute cannot be updated.

options.name: system_volume_type
options.description: Volume type for the system volume This attribute cannot be updated.

options.name: termination_action
options.description: Force destroy avoids to bypass standard validations and directly deletes the instance.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The maximum number of seconds to wait for the async action to complete.

options.name: user_data
options.description: Additional data that will be added to instance on provisioning This attribute cannot be updated.

options.name: wait
options.description: A boolean value that defines whether to wait for the async action to complete.
